meta.text: Let's put numbers on it with the worked example. Take an eight terabyte table and three candidate keys. If we partition on order_date across three years, that's roughly one thousand ninety-five partitions, about seven gigabytes each — well inside our guardrails. Now imagine two point four million partitions from an order_id or a large per-user count: those are millions of tiles of tiny data, and the guardrails collapse immediately.
